The band QWER took its first step into Japan with an intense and energetic charm.

On the 8th QWER announced the opening theme song for the Japanese animation "The Tomb Raider King," "Show Down (SHOW DOWN)," officially signaling their local debut.

This song captures QWER's new charm well. Unlike before, it conveys an energetic appeal with an intense yet powerful band sound. It contained a bold message of "breaking through without worrying about others' gazes."

Through this "The Tomb Raider King" opening theme "Show Down," QWER is conveying their unique new charm and message and officially announcing their full-scale global activities.

They participated not only in the opening theme for "The Tomb Raider King" but also in the ending theme "To Be Continued," foreshadowing active activities alongside their official Japanese debut.
